scope: Source-derived continuity for this unapproved D037 comparison batch.

bhudevi.visual: Dignified adult Earth Goddess with natural proportions and exactly two attached arms. Warm cream, muted ochre and restrained earth-green sari.

shiva.visual: Mature ash-toned ascetic deity with natural adult proportions, exactly two attached arms, calm guiding presence, simple ochre and cream cloth, restrained rudraksha; one upright trident may be carried in one attached hand.

devas.visual: Small assembly of distinct adult humanlike witnesses with natural proportions, two attached arms and legs each, varied faces, age, clothing and pose.

yogamaya.visual: Use the existing Yogamaya continuity sheet only as identity context; this stanza's approved composition represents the transfer symbolically and does not depict Yogamaya as an embodied figure.

adishesha.visual: Use the existing Adishesha continuity sheet only as identity context; show the stanza's transfer as one continuous ivory-white serpent-light path, not as a separate multi-hood deity figure.

asuras.visual: Distant ordinary humanlike opponents with natural proportions and two attached arms and legs; conflict remains a quiet, non-graphic aftermath.
never: fantasy armor copied from the source

kamsa.visual: One recurring adult Mathuran king with a strong human face, dark hair, natural proportions and exactly two attached arms; restrained maroon and ochre royal cloth with simple headwear.

newborn.visual: One unharmed infant, fully swaddled and gently supported by the adults, with a natural peaceful face.

rohini.visual: Adult woman with natural proportions, exactly two attached arms, composed face, modest warm-cream sari with muted green accents.

rendering: Use the series flat matte South Indian temple mural treatment with broad opaque mineral colour fields, dark drawn contours and painted ochre ornaments; no glossy shading, metallic reflections, cinematic lighting, outer border, text, signature or watermark.
